rival_explanations: It is a sentence-end detector rather than a line-break detector: any sentence-final '.' '?' '!' or ';' fires it wherever it sits, so single-sentence texts ending in a period and mid-paragraph sentence ends with no break are predicted active.

It fires only on a paragraph break that follows sentence-final punctuation in running prose; a mid-clause line wrap after a comma or a bare word, and a break after an exclamation, are predicted inactive.
